results.question: How many days do I have to request a refund?
results.answer: Customers have up to 30 days from the purchase date to request a refund【1】.

results.question: How long does a refund take to reach my card?
results.answer: Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after the request is approved [1].

results.question: Can I get a refund on a gift card?
results.answer: No. Gift cards are non‑refundable once the card code has been delivered, except where required by law [1].

results.question: When are shipping costs refunded?
results.answer: Shipping costs are refunded only if the item arrived damaged or the wrong item was shipped [1].

results.question: How many vacation days do full-time employees get per year?
results.answer: Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per year【1】.

results.question: How many vacation days can be carried over?
results.answer: Up to 5 unused vacation days may be carried over to the next calendar year [1].

results.question: How many paid sick days do I get?
results.answer: You receive 10 paid sick days per year [1].

results.question: How long is parental leave for primary caregivers?
results.answer: Primary caregivers are entitled to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. [1]

results.question: How much bereavement leave for an immediate family member?
results.answer: Employees are entitled to up to 5 paid days of bereavement leave for the death of an immediate family member【1】.

results.question: How many days a week can I work remotely?
results.answer: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week [1].

results.question: How much is the home office stipend for fully remote employees?
results.answer: The home office stipend for fully remote employees is a one‑time payment of 500 USD [1].

results.question: What are the core working hours for remote staff?
results.answer: Remote staff must be available during core hours of 10:00 to 15:00 in their local time zone【1】.

results.question: Do I need approval to work abroad for three weeks?
results.answer: Yes. Working from another country for more than 14 days in a calendar year requires prior approval from HR【1】.

results.question: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling?
results.answer: The daily meal allowance for business travel is up to 60 USD per day【1】.

results.question: Is alcohol reimbursable?
results.answer: No. Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances. [1]

results.question: How soon must I submit an expense report?
results.answer: Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of the expense date [2].

results.question: What is the nightly hotel limit in London?
results.answer: The hotel reimbursement limit for London is 250 USD per night【1】.

results.question: When do I need pre-approval for an expense?
results.answer: Pre‑approval is required for any expense of 500 USD or more (any single expense above 500 USD must have written approval from the department head)【1】【2】

results.question: How long are reimbursements paid after approval?
results.answer: Reimbursements are paid within 10 business days after approval【1】.

results.question: How long must my password be?
results.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long【1】.

results.question: How quickly must I report a lost laptop?
results.answer: Lost laptops (or any lost or stolen devices) must be reported to IT within 2 hours of discovery [1][2].

results.question: How often do passwords need to be changed?
results.answer: Passwords must be changed every 180 days [1].

results.question: Within what time must phishing emails be reported?
results.answer: Phishing emails must be reported within 1 hour [2]

results.question: What percentage of health premium does the company pay for employees?
results.answer: The company pays 90 percent of the health‑insurance premium for the employee【1】.

results.question: What is the 401k employer match?
results.answer: The employer matches 4 percent of an employee’s 401(k) contributions. [1]

results.question: How big is the annual learning budget?
results.answer: The annual learning budget is 1,500 USD per employee [1].

results.question: When can I join the stock purchase plan?
results.answer: Employees become eligible for the employee stock purchase plan after six months of employment [1].

results.question: What is the maximum gift value I can accept from a vendor?
results.answer: The policy permits accepting gifts up to 75 USD; any gift worth more than 75 USD from a vendor (or customer) is prohibited【1】.

results.question: Is there an anonymous way to report concerns?
results.answer: Yes—concerns can be reported anonymously through the ethics hotline at 1‑800‑555‑0100【1】.
